entries.label: Loading dock
entries.note: North face, off the service alley: the only truck-height door. Deliveries stop at 6 pm and the bay goes dark.

entries.label: Garage ramp
entries.note: East face: the ramp down to three levels of parking under the plaza. The gate arm lifts for any badged car.

entries.label: Main lobby
entries.note: South face, on the plaza: revolving doors, a desk staffed around the clock, turnstiles to the lift banks.

entries.label: Stair B exit
entries.note: West face, onto Hope Street: a fire exit from stair B. Alarmed, and it opens outward only.

entries.label: Roof hatch
entries.note: Beside the cooling towers. The hatch drops into the stair A core above the 42nd floor.
